page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-288 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the c4 instance family. It features 288 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. This configuration consists of 144 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2.0 threads per core. The processor architecture includes a 504 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It is equipped with 1080.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 3.75 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU accelerators, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the c4-standard-288 demonstrates top-tier multi-core processing capabilities. The multi-core stress-ng CPU performance and PassMark CPU score both rank in the top 10% of tested systems, supported by advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations. Memory subsystem performance is also in the top 10%, with cached small-block read bandwidth reaching 22,997.34 GB/sec and uncached large-block read bandwidth at 1,062.04 GB/sec. Database operations, static web serving throughput at 202.24 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations at 406.06 million operations per second also place this server in the top tier.

While multi-threaded execution and memory bandwidth are exceptionally strong, single-core performance presents certain tradeoffs. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance falls within the middle 50% average. Additionally, while prompt processing for medium (7B) and large (70B) LLM models ranks in the top tier and strong categories respectively, text generation for small (135M) models is weak, scoring in the bottom 25%. Given these characteristics, the server is highly efficient for massive parallel workloads such as software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded decompression, but less optimal for single-threaded tasks or small-model text generation.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-288 is an x86_64 compute-optimized server featuring 288 dedicated vCPUs from Intel Xeon 6985P-C processors at 2.3 GHz, paired with 1080.0 GB of RAM. Lacking local storage and GPUs, it relies on high-density compute resources. Benchmarks place its multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations in the top 10% tier, aided by Intel AMX and AVX-512 extensions. However, single-core stress-ng performance is average, and text generation for small LLM models is weak. This server is best suited for highly parallelized workloads, including software compilation, large-scale database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression.
